packageRules.description: Runtime deps: patch/minor grouped, automerge, release patch
Dev deps: patch/minor grouped, automerge, no release
Blocked: TypeScript 7 native compiler breaks ts-node, ts-jest and typescript-eslint (fileExists/LineFeed of undefined). Lift when the toolchain supports it.
Blocked: @helia/libp2p 2 requires helia 8 service factories (createService is not a function at runtime).
Blocked: @libp2p/interface 3.3 is type-incompatible with the pinned @libp2p/utils stream classes (TS2420/TS2344).
Blocked: @haskou/value-objects 8.4 changes UUID static side; every UUID subclass fails TS2417. Needs a dedicated migration PR.
Blocked: @haskou/eslint-config 0.2.2 tightens member-ordering on protected fields; needs a dedicated lint cleanup PR.
Held back: @cucumber/cucumber 13.2.0 and later with cucumber-tsflow fail with Reflect.getMetadata is not a function (PRs #258, #768, #773). Lift when #778 is fixed.
Held back: @helia/bitswap 4.0.20 breaks scripts/patch-helia-bitswap-limited-connections.js with Unable to patch network.js (PRs #279, #767, #772). Lift when #777 is fixed.
Held back: helia 7.1.16 and later pull @helia/bitswap ^4.0.20, which breaks scripts/patch-helia-bitswap-limited-connections.js. Lift when #777 is fixed.
